definition: what my brain has left to start things with

settled:
Mana is my executive function bar: the neurotransmitters and energy in my brain that effortful work runs on. Executive function is my other name for it.

Every call on executive function is metabolically expensive, so each one spends mana. Stress capacity is paid separately.

I read it as a stoplight, off how much I want to do. Green is wanting to do everything. Yellow is wanting to do some things, where rationing starts and my rule that if I do not want to I cannot fires earlier. Red is not wanting to do anything.

What it reports is wanting, not capability. Low mana shows as not wanting to engage rather than as knowing a task and failing to run it.

Executive function was a real bottleneck of mine before safety took the place over.

Three things retired it. Nervous system recovery, which was the slowest and the largest. The harness I built. And Vyvanse, which is the one I notice most and not the one that moved the most.
